blockingFindings.description: Sit and crouch show large, sharp white shorts flares at the knees after increasing hem thigh weight. The higher weight improves measured upper-thigh ray coverage from 15.6% to 42.6% in sit, but the actual garment deformation is visibly worse and still leaves broad anterior thigh areas exposed.

In seated and crouched views the overskirt lifts away from the thighs, leaving pointed separated front/side panels and dense accordion ridges. The skirt still does not provide continuous front coverage through the poses.
Neutral and standing views retain pronounced ribbed side folds and an uneven front/side hem; the V78 weight-only trial does not produce a coherent finished silhouette.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
